artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the two linear test Volterra functional integral equations with proportional vanishing delay on $I=[0,\infty)$:
(E1) $u(t) = 1 + \int_0^{qt} (a + b\,u(s))\,ds$, $t\ge 0$,
(E2) $u(t) = 1 + \int_0^{t} a\,u(s)\,ds + \int_0^{qt} b\,u(s)\,ds$, $t\ge 0$,
where $0<q<1$ and $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$ are chosen so that the exact solution satisfies $\lim_{t\to\infty}u(t)=0$ (asymptotic stability).

Fix an integer $m\ge 1$ and collocation parameters $0\le c_1<c_2<\cdots<c_m\le 1$. Let $I_h$ be the uniform mesh $t_n=nh$, $n=0,1,2,\ldots$, with stepsize $h>0$, and let 
$$S^{(-1)}_{m-1}(I_h)=\{v:\ v|_{(t_n,t_{n+1}]}\in\mathbb{P}_{m-1}\text{ for all }n\ge 0\}$$
be the space of (possibly discontinuous) piecewise polynomials of degree at most $m-1$. The collocation solution $u_h\in S^{(-1)}_{m-1}(I_h)$ is defined by requiring that it satisfies the integral equation exactly at the collocation points $t_{n,i}=t_n+c_i h$, $i=1,\ldots,m$; the iterated collocation solution $u_h^{\mathrm{it}}(t)$ is obtained by substituting $u_h$ into the right-hand side of the equation.

Determine all choices of collocation parameters $\{c_i\}_{i=1}^m\subset[0,1]$ for which, for every sufficiently small $h>0$,
$$\lim_{t\to\infty} u_h(t)=0\quad\text{and}\quad \lim_{t\to\infty} u_h^{\mathrm{it}}(t)=0$$
hold for both test equations (E1) and (E2).
artifact.category_tag: Collocation methods for delay Volterra equations
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature (including work on asymptotic stability of Volterra functional equations with vanishing delays and on collocation/superconvergence for pantograph-type VFIEs) still lists the characterization of collocation parameters yielding discrete asymptotic stability on uniform meshes for these test VFIEs as an open question. Partial results exist for delay differential equations with proportional delay and for quasi-geometric meshes, but no complete answer for the VFIE collocation case appears to be established.

status_evidence.title: On the asymptotic stability of Volterra functional equations with vanishing delays
status_evidence.snippet: Analyzes asymptotic stability of solutions of linear Volterra integral equations with vanishing delays; the discrete (collocation) counterpart on uniform meshes is mentioned as open.
status_evidence.claim: Continuous-stability problem addressed, discrete collocation analogue on uniform meshes remains open.

status_evidence.title: Stability of collocation methods for delay differential equations with vanishing delays
status_evidence.snippet: Studies asymptotic stability of collocation solutions on uniform meshes for linear DDEs with vanishing proportional delay.
status_evidence.claim: Related DDE case partially analyzed; VFIE case still subject to open problems.

status_evidence.title: Optimal superconvergence results for Volterra functional integral equations with proportional vanishing delays
status_evidence.snippet: Recent superconvergence results for VFIEs with proportional vanishing delays, focusing on convergence orders rather than long-time discrete stability.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work focuses on superconvergence; the discrete asymptotic stability characterization for VFIEs is not settled.
